note: Schema fidelity: a struct #[serde(tag)] is documented as a required tag property in the response view (left out of the {Name}Input request view, since serde never reads it); Option of a type-less inline schema (oneOf / allOf) keeps null via anyOf, and Option of an inline string enum lists null; multipart field names use form_data(field_name) before serde rename in the request view, and the Multipart derive reads the deserialize-side serde rename / rename_all
